# IU Blogs

> > Educational blogging platform hosting community blogs from Indiana University departments, research labs, and academic units including the Luddy Department of Information & Library Science, School of Optometry, and Center for Innovative Teaching & Learning.

IU Blogs is a WordPress multisite platform powered by CampusPress that provides blog hosting for Indiana University's academic community. The platform supports departmental news, research lab updates, newsletters, and educational content across IU's Bloomington and Indianapolis campuses.

## Key Topics

- IU Blogs platform
- Indiana University
- Educational blogs

## Platform Overview

- [IU Blogs – Educational blogs from our community](https://blogs.iu.edu): Homepage for IU Blogs WordPress multisite platform by CampusPress
- [Sites – IU Blogs](https://blogs.iu.edu/blogs): Directory listing of all blog sites on IU Blogs platform
- [Categories – IU Blogs](https://blogs.iu.edu/categories): Browse IU Blogs by category taxonomy

## Library and Information Science

- [Luddy Department of Information & Library Science Blog](https://blogs.iu.edu/ilsnewsletter): ILS Newsletter and news from Luddy Information & Library Science Dept
- [IU Indianapolis Department of Library and Information Science](https://blogs.iu.edu/dlis): DLIS community news from IU Indianapolis Library & Information Science

## School of Optometry and Research

- [Indiana University School of Optometry News](https://blogs.iu.edu/iusonews): IU School of Optometry news covering students, faculty, staff, and alumni
- [About Us – Clinical Optics Research Lab](https://blogs.iu.edu/corl/about-us): About Clinical Optics Research Lab at IU School of Optometry
- [CORL Study FAQ – Clinical Optics Research Lab](https://blogs.iu.edu/corl/research-participant-faq): FAQ for Clinical Optics Research Lab study participants

## Teaching and Learning

- [Center for Innovative Teaching & Learning](https://blogs.iu.edu/citl): Center for Innovative Teaching & Learning blog on educational practices
